name: Portals of the Legion
summary: After Hand of Iruxos, Taiga Wisemane in Shadowprey Village shows you the Hand and asks you to banish six demon portals at Mannoroc Coven, warning you to be wary of the portal guardians.

sections.title: Closing the Gates
sections.body: Taiga Wisemane holds up the Hand of Iruxos, a grisly thing to look at, and says you must carry it if the demon portals around Mannoroc Coven are ever to be closed. The demon threat is increasing, and shutting the portals will check the number of demons crossing into this world. She wants all six portals banished, and she warns you to be wary of their guardians.

faq.q: What is needed to banish the portals?
faq.answer: The Hand of Iruxos. Taiga Wisemane says you must possess it for the portals to be banished.

faq.q: Who asks you to banish the portals?
aliases: who gives portals of the legion

faq.q: How many portals must be banished?

faq.answer: Hand of Iruxos, in which Taiga Wisemane sent you to Thunder Axe Fortress for the Demon Box.
